answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fakes. Each agent, a vertex in the graph, posts a 40 POA bond, a jade seal. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of vertices for peer replay. Shared-controller fakes lose the bond; slashed funds pay auditors. Forging 100 identities locks 4,000 POA, and at 5% per epoch nearly every fake is caught in 20 epochs. An honest agent risks one bond and keeps it, while fakes collapse like a dune, honest earnings undiluted.
